references.text: Repeats the counting of the tribe of Asher with the same number (41,500) when they are organized in the camp around the tabernacle.
The second census of the tribe of Asher on the plains of Moab shows 53,400, an increase from the original 41,500.
Asher was born to Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, as Jacob's son and ancestor of the tribe of Asher.
Lists the sons of Asher who went down to Egypt, the ancestors of those counted in the wilderness.
Jacob's blessing over Asher, prophesying that the tribe would have rich food and royal delicacies.
